tools.name: lookup_token
tools.description: The pre-trade check. Look up a token by chain and contract address: which legal wrapper issued it, what holding it entitles you to, with the supporting quotes. A token XRADE has not covered gets an explicit 'not covered' answer, never a blank.

tools.name: lookup_stock
tools.description: Look up a stock or asset by ticker or name. Returns every tokenised version the record holds, grouped by legal wrapper, plus tokens seen on chain that are not yet resolved. Versions are unranked and listed alphabetically.

tools.name: wrapper_record
tools.description: The full legal record of one wrapper: structure, holder claim, insolvency ranking, redemption, dividends, voting, transfer restrictions. Every stated fact carries its supporting quote, source and dates. Fields nobody examined and fields no document discloses are distinguished and say so.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: What the record covers and, as importantly, what it knows it has not covered: the denominator of tokens seen on chain and not yet resolved to any wrapper.
